output.summary: The turnover rise is real: it matches payroll records and exceeds the peer rise (28% to 47% against 33% to 38%). It is not a migration artifact. The rise began before ShiftWise go-live. Monthly separations stepped up in March, when the Saturday policy took effect at all branches. Exit-survey schedule complaints rose from 19% to 48%. Pay is a plausible contributor, but the market gap is unmeasured. The last study was in 2023, and the recruiter scan is anecdotal. The manager hypothesis rests on a stale manager field and anecdote. The 15% raise is costly and not practically reversible, so it is premature. Punishing managers using the stale field is harmful. Next steps are the by-branch report and ShiftWise comparison, plus a market benchmark. A targeted adjustment can still go through the January cycle.
